items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Skitch Henderson and Monk Rowe beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Skitch was interviewed at his home in New Milford, Connecticut on October 31, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. And it’s quite an honor to be here at The Silo outside New Milford, Connecticut with one of the most distinguished members of America’s musical community.
